description: This file contains C source code for testing and benchmarking a hashmap implementation, including functions for creating entries, comparing entries, hashing, and performance testing commands.

methods.name: test_entry_cmp
methods.description: Compares two hashmap entries based on their keys, optionally ignoring case.

methods.name: alloc_test_entry
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new test_entry with a given hash, key, and value.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value based on the specified method, index, and key.

methods.name: perf_hashmap
methods.description: Performs performance testing of the hashmap with specified method and rounds.

methods.name: cmd__hashmap
methods.description: Command-line interface for testing hashmap performance based on input commands.
